m: {Lara Croft} vaults {Inside} the {Mansion} and trips an ancient trap, sending a boulder thundering down the grand stairs. She backflips onto a *tree* growing through the hall, where an *orchid* whips out its stem and lashes the branches into a **railing**. The boulder bounces off the **railing**, and Lara strikes a pose on top, ponytail swinging.

{Sherlock} crouches in the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} with his magnifying glass, watching a *snapped stick* tick like a clock hand across a tiny *road* of wax. From one crumb of pollen he deduces that a bee will **pass by** at noon, then a decade, then his whole youth. He murmurs "Elementary" through a long white beard while Watson and the years **pass by** without stopping.

{Chewbacca} tiptoes through the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave}, huge and hairy and trying to be silent, because his ship needs one last part. Deep in the *cave* a crossbow bolt makes a neat *cut* in the sleeping yeti's toolbag, and he **steals** the spanner. His joyful roar wakes everyone, and the yeti bellows that a walking carpet came to **steal** his tools.

{Yoshi} flicks his tongue in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, swallowing a stalk of *wheat* and then the *rainbow* shining in the shower steam. The *rainbow* glows through his belly as he squeaks, strains and lays one dazzling egg, sequinned and far too **glamorous** for a bathtub. The butler faints, and the egg poses on a towel, the most **glamorous** thing Yoshi has ever laid.

{Charlie Brown} opens the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} to fly his kite indoors, the one place no tree can eat it. A green cloud of *stink* seizes the string and drags him through a week-old fish stew. He comes out so **smelly** that Snoopy packs a bag, and even the kite-eating tree spits out his **smelly** kite.

{Shrek} stomps out in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange}, roaring at a *thousand ants* who are stealing his onion lunch. They haul each layer along a *silk thread* so **fine** that Donkey walks straight through it without pausing his chatter. Grumbling, Shrek peels his last layer until it is just as **fine**, and the ants wave it over their heads like a flag.

{James Bond} straightens his tuxedo in {Front} of the {Beach} and plays cards with a *king* across a *small table*. The *king* stakes an **irregular pearl**, lumpy as a potato, which is really a gadget from Q that does one absurd thing: it sprouts a propeller. The **irregular pearl** wobbles crookedly out to sea, the *small table* scuttling after it, and Bond calls that a fair bluff.

{Kermit} flails his arms in {Front} of the {Hut}, stage-managing a musical where every *tree* must hop on cue. His banjo is the **counter for trees**: one twang, one *tree*, and a panicked "Yaaay!" for each. When he loses count, the cast hurls *fruit* at him, so he ducks, hops back and starts the **counter for trees** again.

{Charlie Brown} hides in the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} until Lucy looks away, then decides to **take advantage of** his one lucky moment. A *runner* with *thick hair* bolts past, and Charlie grabs the hair like a kite string and flies behind him over the rides. Then a tree eats them both, and Snoopy, on the ground, is quick to **take advantage of** it by finishing Charlie's candy floss.

{James Bond} strolls into the {Bathroom} of the {Stadium}, where Q's oldest **craftsman** lifts a gadget from an *open crate*. It is an *axe* that does one absurd thing: it carves tiny perfect chairs. Bond gives it one bored swing, and a whole wooden grandstand of them tumbles out, while the old **craftsman** weeps with pride and Bond brushes sawdust off his tuxedo.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps {Inside} the {Boxing Ring} and swallows a *brimming cup* in one long slurp. He lays it as an egg on a *dish*, and the egg starts pouring tea from a crack and will not stop. The *dish* is **filled**, then the ring is **filled** to the ropes, and the boxers paddle around Yoshi, who bobs along squeaking his own name.

{Walter White} sets out his beakers in {Front} of the {Jungle} and pours a school experiment on ageing, proud of every decimal place. One drop lands on a passing *grandpa*, whose beard races to his knees until he is the oldest **old man** on Earth. Walter adjusts his glasses and takes notes, while the **old man** raps on the beaker, wheezing that he is the one who knocks.

{Charlie Brown} sits gloomily {Inside} the {Boathouse}, because *autumn* has arrived, and *autumn* means Lucy and the football. Every falling leaf makes his *heart* thump under his zigzag shirt. He begins to **worry** about the kick, the sky, the boats and the leaves, and he goes on to **worry** so hard that the boats start to sink out of sympathy.

{Sherlock} leans in the {Bathroom} of the {Casino}, one huge *eye* behind his magnifying glass, watching a card cheat's sleeve. In one *eyeblink* the ace has moved, yet he can solve it all from a single crumb if only he does not **blink**. Watson sneezes, Sherlock has to **blink**, and the cheat, the cards and his pipe are gone.

{Yoshi} waddles out in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} and lays an enormous spotted egg. It cracks, and out crawls a *baby* in red gloves, an **infant** who decides Yoshi is its mother. Each time the **infant** crawls under the ropes, Yoshi's long sticky tongue gently reels it back, and each time it punches the tongue and giggles.

{Shrek} roars in the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café}, wanting only to be left alone, but a *dutiful son* marches in with his old father on his back and starts washing the old man's feet in the sink. Shrek peels his onion, layer after layer, and finds **filial piety** at its heart. Grumbling, he goes off to phone his ogre dad, while Donkey will not shut up about **filial piety**.

{James Bond} stands unruffled in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} when Q hands him a book with one loose *page*. It leaps out and folds round his **neck** as a paper bow tie, a gadget that does one absurd thing: it stretches. His **neck** rises like a giraffe's until his head pokes through the ring, and from up there he introduces himself to the referee.

{Tarzan} swings on a vine through the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, baffled by an *attic* dangling from the ceiling, where a *standing person* dithers at the hatch. The apes taught him only one word of human talk, and he bellows it with his jungle yell. **If** you jump, Tarzan catch; **if** you stay, the *attic* shakes until you do.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and offers a squirting flower that sprays so many *water drops* he floats out to sea. Grinning, he paddles with a *snapped stick* until green tea hills rise up: **Zhejiang**. The tea pickers lean in to sniff his flower, get soaked, and squirt him back with their teapots, shouting that **Zhejiang** always returns a prank.

{Lara Croft} climbs up through the {Bathroom} of the {Stadium} into a buried *palace*, snatches a relic and sets a boulder rolling through the stone queen's cake. A *small speech bubble* floats from the statue's lips, saying the queen will **excuse** her. Lara backflips, flattens a second cake, and the bubble sighs that it will **excuse** her once more before the spikes come out.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} just as a sandstorm screams in. A gadget from his utility belt weaves *grass* and *rags* into an emergency cape, which he throws up to **shield** Alfred's sandwiches while sand pings off it like hail. The *rags* flap and the *grass* holds, and Batman growls that he will **shield** the smallest crab in the city too.

{Charlie Brown} lines up the football in the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar}, propped on a *skewer* because Lucy cannot be trusted. *Sun rays* pour through a window and melt a block of butter across the tiles, leaving the floor perfectly **smooth**. His run-up is **smooth** for once in his life, so he glides straight past the ball and out among the planes, sighing "Good grief."

{Zorro} swings on a chandelier into the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle}, rapier flashing, and slashes a Z into a glittering *shell*. He lifts it from a bamboo *steamer* with a dashing bow to **present** it to a startled gorilla. The *steamer* puffs a cloud, Zorro vanishes laughing, and the gorilla wakes next morning to find him waiting to **present** a second one.

{Naruto} skids to a halt in {Front} of the {Beach}, where a *woman* and a *nun* are arguing over who minds a little **girl**. He yells that he will never give up on babysitting and makes shadow clones by the dozen, all in orange, all holding ramen. The **girl** defeats every clone with a sand bucket while the *woman* and the *nun* cheer.

{Sherlock} kneels in {Front} of the {Spa} with his magnifying glass as the *grass* trembles and the warm *sand* shifts. From one tiny footprint he deduces the culprit: green, long-legged and musical. He tries a tune on his violin, and a **katydid** springs out and plays it back better. Smugly he declares the case closed, while the **katydid** kicks sand on Watson.

{Walter White} knocks at the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} in his black hat, and a brass-buttoned *officer* comes to inspect his school experiment. Proudly, Walter drops one precise pellet into a beaker, and foam full of brass buttons pours into the water. Each fish that touches it snaps to attention, until every fish is an **officer** saluting, and the first **officer** salutes them back.

{Darth Vader} breathes loudly in the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon} and raises one glove, using the Force to drag in a wind from the *east*. It howls, *icicles* shoot from his helmet, and the waves **freeze** in mid-curl. He Force-chokes a dripping tap until it starts to **freeze** as well, then booms his disapproval at the flamingos.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} exactly when he means to, slams his staff down and thunders "You shall not pass!" at a *teetering man* in the queue. A spell conjures a *kicking foot* that taps the man behind the knees, and he has to **kneel**. Patients, nurses and the receptionist all **kneel** in a row as the wizard lights his pipe.

{Charlie Brown} climbs on a *horse* in the {Basement} by the {Swamp}, determined that just once he will win. They **charge** at the locked *gate*, frogs scattering, but at the last second Lucy whisks the *gate* away like a football. The *horse* stops dead, Charlie alone keeps trying to **charge**, flying through empty air into the mud, and he sighs "Good grief."

{Pikachu} bounces {Inside} the {Pool}, where *grass* grows on every step and a slow *crawler* drags a giant **grape** flying the flag of **Portugal**. Sparks fizz in his cheeks and a Thunderbolt hits, so the **grape** bursts purple across the water. The *crawler* squeaks with fury and turns round for the long crawl home to **Portugal**, while Pikachu licks his paw.

{Homer} sneaks a doughnut in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and hears *footsteps* **behind** him. He spins around with a "D'oh!" but sees nobody, so he hides the doughnut **behind** his back. The *footsteps* pad closer, there is a soft munch, and when he brings his hand back round the doughnut has one neat bite missing.

{Charlie Brown} tries to cook Snoopy's supper {Inside} the {Pool}, in a **kitchen** carved into a *cliff*. The *cliff* gives a shrug and drops a boulder on his stove, sending every pot into the deep end. Swimmers wave for lunch and Snoopy looks on from his doghouse, as Charlie mutters "Good grief" and the whole **kitchen** slides slowly into the water.

{Yoshi} flicks his tongue in {Front} of the {Spa} and swallows a *bird* clanking in *armour*. He strains and lays a steel-plated egg, which rattles, quacks and bursts open. Out waddles a **duck** knight, visor up, honking a battle cry and charging straight at the hot tub, and Yoshi flutter-jumps after the brave **duck** just in time to see the belly flop.

{Darth Vader} raises one glove in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} and lifts himself with the Force to the very **top** of the flagpole. There he settles into a *headstand*, cape flopping over his helmet, breathing slowly and loudly as coins rain from his pockets. From the **top** he booms his disapproval at the whole city, upside down.

The {Joker} cackles in {Front} of the {Hut} after his exploding-pie prank blasts a whole *kitchen* out onto the *road*. An inspector is coming, so he deals out giant trick playing cards to **cover up** the mess, wallpapering the *road* and hiding every pot. The inspector lifts one card and gets squirted, and the Joker grins and moves to **cover up** the inspector too.

{Yoshi} pops into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and finds a *cozy room* full of lonely crabs. A *small speech bubble* floats over each crab, asking for a friend. His tongue slurps up every bubble, and he lays one huge warm egg of **friendship** for them all to sit on. The sea rolls in, but the **friendship** floats with everyone aboard.

The {Joker} tiptoes into the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} with a shovel and a grin, digs a **ditch** through the *soil* and hides it under trick playing cards. A little *river* gushes in. Visitors step on the cards and whoosh away, shrieking with joy, and he cackles so hard he topples into the **ditch** himself, his squirting flower still going.

{Yoshi} gets a hungry look in the {Bathroom} of the {Museum}, beside a *coat stand* with a wailing *mouth*. The *mouth* begins to **implore** him not to swallow it as his long tongue unrolls across the tiles. He gulps it down anyway and lays it as a spotted egg, and from within the shell it goes on trying to **implore** him, muffled.

{Lara Croft} somersaults {Inside} the {Casino} and finds an ancient puzzle door behind the roulette wheel. To stop the boulder overhead she must **arrange** the chips in the right order, so she flips across the tables building one *neat stack*. The *neat stack* clicks into its slot, the door grinds open, and out of sheer habit she goes on to **arrange** the dealer's eyebrows.

{Pikachu} bursts from his Poké Ball in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} beside a sweating *pioneer* whose machete cannot dent the wall of jungle. Cheeks crackling, he squeals "Pika!" and a Thunderbolt blasts the vines aside to **open up** a trail. The *pioneer* marches on through the smoke, and Pikachu zaps on ahead until he has managed to **open up** the whole island.

{Lara Croft} rappels {Inside} the {Youth Hostel} to raid an ancient *sickbed* said to hide a relic. Under the pillow she finds a pharaoh's stone **tumor**, kept as a *keepsake* in a jar with a plaque. The moment she lifts the **tumor**, a boulder rolls, the *sickbed* shoots off on hidden wheels, and Lara rides it past the startled backpackers.

{Sailor Moon} begins her long sparkly transformation in the {Basement} of the {Tower} when a *woman* bursts in to shout that the table is not set: her **sister-in-law**. An *elder* joins the nagging. Sailor Moon cries loudly, gives a speech about justice and dumplings, and throws her tiara, which the **sister-in-law** catches and wears to serve the soup while Luna sighs.

{Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Warehouse} and lands, baffled, on a floor that has tilted into a grassy *hillside*. He hisses a greeting to a passing *serpent*, who offers him a ride, so he grabs its tail and they rocket down the **slope** like a sled. The *serpent* calls the turns, and at the foot of the **slope** they plough into a forklift, a thing Tarzan greets as a rude elephant.

{Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Swamp}, where a huge *picture frame* hangs nailed to a *tree* for tonight's show. He flails at the curtain, shrieks "Yaaay!" and leaps, landing stuck in the **frame** with his legs dangling. The *tree* sways, the crowd applauds this lifelike portrait of panic, and from his **frame** Kermit sighs that it is not easy being green.

{Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Mansion} on a chandelier, baffled by all the guests' name tags. A *small speech bubble* pops up over each guest, announcing "Tan!", so he decides it must be how people say hello. He beats his chest and yells it back, and everyone of the **surname Tan** rushes to hug him, until the apes outside apply for the **surname Tan** too.

{Homer} naps in {Front} of the {Jungle} against a golden *shrine hall*, with a dim scheme: leave one doughnut as an offering and collect two. The *shrine hall* rumbles and coughs out doughnuts by the cartload, and he is suddenly **prosperous**. "Mmm, **prosperous**," he drools, stretching out on the pile, until monkeys open a bank and foreclose on him. "D'oh!"

{Chewbacca} roars in a temper in {Front} of the {Inn} because a guest's huge *yawn* has blown away his *gold coins*. The guest looks up at him and simply yawns again, a thing nobody dares do to a furious Wookiee. Chewbacca falls silent, lays his bandolier at the guest's feet and growls deeply, in words only friends understand, that he must **respect** this. The whole inn learns to **respect** him too.

{Yoshi} swallows a plain wooden *shed* in {Front} of the {Lagoon}, hoping to lay some treasure. He flutter-jumps, squeaks and strains, and the egg that drops out is completely **ordinary**. It cracks open, and the *shed* unfolds itself again with one chair, one broom and one sock. Tourists applaud politely and take photos of the most **ordinary** miracle they have ever seen.

{Chewbacca} loses his temper in the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} and rips the sink off the wall, flattening *two sheaves* of wheat drying there. His next furious roar shrinks into a sheepish *yawn*, so he fixes the sink and growls long and low to **apologize**. The banker hears only terrifying noises and hastily begins to **apologize** as well.

The {Joker} grins in {Front} of the {Beehive} and hides beside a *winding path*, lying flat in the *grass*. It is **zoysia grass**, so soft that passers-by lie down for a nap, and his green hair makes perfect camouflage. When the sleepers begin to snore, he pops up cackling from the **zoysia grass** and soaks each one with his squirting flower.

{Homer} drops his doughnut down a dark *hole* in the {Basement} of the {Boathouse}, cries "D'oh!" and presses his *mouth* to the opening. He lets out a mighty **roar** demanding it back, and from far below something answers with an even bigger **roar**. Boats rattle, oars leap off the walls, and the doughnut flies up again, neatly half eaten.

{Frodo} trudges on bare hairy feet into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, weary from a very long walk, and sinks down on a *seedbed*. **Just** as he sits, sprouts shove up between his toes. He sighs to Sam that he has **just** got here, but the *seedbed* heaves up a beanstalk that carries him off on another journey.

{Sherlock} studies a washing line in {Front} of the {Mansion} through his magnifying glass, where one *shirt* has sprouted *bristles* like a hedgehog. From a single thread he deduces that this **garment** went for a walk on Tuesday with a hedgehog. The *bristles* twitch in agreement, and he smugly says "Elementary" as Watson tries on the **garment** and yelps.

{Tarzan} drops in {Front} of the {Mansion}, opens a *helping hand* and speaks softly in bird to a *caught bird*. Freed and grateful, it starts to **spread out** its wings, wider and wider, until they cover the lawn like a picnic cloth. Baffled by the butler's napkins, Tarzan gives his jungle yell, and all his animal friends arrive to **spread out** on the feathers for lunch.

{Yoshi} wanders into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} to find a **banquet** laid out beneath a glass *roof*, with a *sunbathing woman* stretched between the turkeys. His tongue shoots out and swallows every dish, and he lays a hundred eggs where the food stood. The *sunbathing woman* lifts her sunglasses, sniffs and asks who ordered an all-egg **banquet**.

The {Joker} grins in the {Basement} of the {Pool} and nails up a giant wind-up *mouth* as a prank. It starts to **instruct** his *kinfolk* to do silly things: Grandma must wear the flower, Uncle must hop, the cousins must quack. They all obey, and he cackles until it turns round to **instruct** him to sit on a whoopee cushion.

The {Joker} flings open a purple *robe* in {Front} of the {Lagoon}, revealing a painted *bullseye* over his heart. He deals trick cards at it, and each card that sticks sings out one of his **inner feelings**: nobody laughs, nobody calls, he only wanted a friend. His huge grin wobbles, so he squirts his flower and cackles to drown out those **inner feelings**.

{James Bond} sits in {Front} of the {Cat Café} as a *woman* refuses to touch the ground, tottering only on golden *stilts*. Q's latest cufflink does one absurd thing, peeling grapes at thirty yards, so he fires it and feeds her from across the street. She is the most **pampered** guest alive, the *stilts* stalk off in a huff when one grape is warm, and Bond remarks that even his drink is less **pampered**.

{Sherlock} lifts one crumb of yellow earth with *tongs* in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} and peers at it through his magnifying glass. From that crumb he deduces **Shaanxi**, and says "Elementary." The *tongs* give a tug, and a whole *hillside* of yellow loess slides through the wall, with clay soldiers marching out of it to stamp **Shaanxi** on Watson's forehead.

{James Bond} stands in the {Basement} of the {Museum} and fires Q's newest wristwatch, which launches an *arrow* carrying a tiny *set square*. It does one absurd thing, enforcing a single **rule**: everything must stand at right angles. Statues snap upright, frames straighten and the *set square* corrects a crooked mummy, and Bond adjusts his bow tie and says a **rule** is a **rule**.

{Pikachu} tumbles out of his Poké Ball in the {Basement} of the {Pool} onto a muddy **river bank** where the tiles should be. A *cattail* tickles his nose, his cheeks spark, and with a sneeze of "Pika!" a Thunderbolt lights every *cattail* like a candle. Otters scold him, and a passing trainer catches him all over again on the **river bank**.

{Yoshi} flicks his tongue in the {Bathroom} of the {Spa} and swallows the *fang* of a sleeping vampire, whose *small speech bubble* asks who took his tooth. Yoshi lays it as an egg, and out hatches a tiny vampire with Yoshi's green nose. Yoshi is **astonished**, and the vampire is more **astonished** still, and the two of them gape at the baby through the steam.

{Sailor Moon} twirls her moon wand in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon}, and a sparkly beam seizes a *follower* by the *ear*. She needs to **raise up** this poor fellow so that he can hear her speech on justice, and his *ear* stretches like rubber toward the ceiling. Then she trips over Luna, cries loudly, and the wand goes on to **raise up** the entire lagoon floor.

{Lara Croft} prises open an ancient crate in the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} and sets off a trap: tiny darts whisk the *shirt* off every piece of *fruit*. Peeled bananas and oranges scatter across the floor, totally **naked** and shrieking. A boulder comes rolling after them, and Lara flips over the **naked** crowd, offering towels as she goes.

{Batman} swoops into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and scans a lump of glowing *amber* with a gadget from his belt. It drips onto a mossy *stone*, which hums, and every wave in the bay turns **bluish green**. His batarang comes back the same **bluish green**, and he broods over the clue, growling at his stained cape.

{Cookie Monster} spots a *lofty peak* in {Front} of the {Waiting Room}, and his googly eyes decide it is a giant cookie. Roaring "Me want cookie!", he reaches out a *helping hand* and begins to **destroy** it in an avalanche of crumbs. He eats the chairs, the clock and the magazines next, announcing happily that he will **destroy** waiting forever.

{Shrek} grumbles in {Front} of the {Inn} as the innkeeper pays his **salary** in bundles of *firewood* tied with *grass*. He wanted onions, and his roar rattles the windows, so the innkeeper nervously adds more until the pile is taller than the lamp post. Donkey chews through the *grass* while lecturing on money, and Shrek's whole **salary** comes crashing down on his head.

{Lara Croft} somersaults {Inside} the {Inn} into a tiny indoor *grove* of lemon trees guarding a relic. A carved puzzle tells her to **sprinkle** each trunk in order, so she hangs by one hand and tips an old urn, and *water drops* patter down until a secret door clicks open. The innkeeper puts up an umbrella, so she stops to **sprinkle** his slippers, just for luck.

{Charlie Brown} misses the football yet again in the {Basement} of the {Beehive}, with the entire hive watching. One bee holds up a tiny *stop sign*, and another buzzes the score into his *ear*. He glows red with **shame** down to his zigzag shirt, and even Snoopy pretends not to know him, leaving Charlie sighing "Good grief" in his deep **shame**.

{James Bond} sits with *crossed legs* in {Front} of the {Cat Café}, testing Q's newest pen under the *moon*. It does one absurd thing, squirting **glue**, and now his *crossed legs* are stuck together for good. When the *moon* dips down for a closer look it sticks to the lamp post, and Bond hops off unruffled, remarking how **glue** to see him it was.

{Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Pool}, baffled by a *busy man* in an apron, a **butcher**, who is sharpening knives over a *lying man* asleep on the steps. Raised by apes, Tarzan takes this for a hunt and lets out his jungle yell. The *lying man* wakes and bolts on the back of an elephant, and the sulky **butcher** slices a pool noodle instead.

{Casper} floats through the wall {Inside} the {Hut}, hoping to befriend a *spearman* who stands guarding a white *bird*. He only says hello, but the *spearman* screams and runs off. The *bird* is a **goose**, afraid of nothing, and she honks and chases Casper through every wall. He turns invisible, and the **goose** bites the empty air exactly where he is.

{James Bond} sits in {Front} of the {Beach} in his tuxedo at a *small table*, absolutely **starving**, and a waiter sets down one *side dish*: a single pea. Q's fork does one absurd thing, launching whatever it touches, so the pea soars off and a seagull takes it. Still **starving**, he raises his empty glass and orders it shaken, not stirred.

{Pikachu} peeks out of his Poké Ball in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, one *eye* fixed on a *cut cake* on the windowsill. He begins to **long for** it so hard that his cheeks spark, and the sparks leap across the room and toast the *cut cake* black. Pulled back into the ball, he goes on to **long for** it through the crack, whispering "Pika."

{Batman} crouches {Inside} the {Fort} as a *comet* streaks past the *moon*, and the detective in him must see where it lands. He clicks a gadget on his belt, a telescoping collar, and his **neck** shoots up the staircase like a grappling line. Thirty feet up, the *moon* ducks in fright, and Batman growls his name from the far end of his **neck**.

{Homer} wakes {Inside} the {Lagoon} from a nap to see a *bug* at a tiny *workbench*, hammering stripes together to build a **rainbow**. He drools "Mmm, sprinkles" and decides it must be icing for some enormous doughnut. One long lick later the whole **rainbow** collapses on his head, his tongue is striped, the *workbench* is flat, and he wails "D'oh!"

{Cookie Monster} barges into the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} and spots a chess *pawn* wearing a hat of *feathers* on a plate. Yelling "Me want cookie!", he chomps it down in a spray of crumbs, and his blue fur flashes **emerald green**. The *feathers* tickle his throat, he burps, and every patient and magazine turns **emerald green** as well.

{Batman} glides in {Front} of the {Jungle} as an *avalanche* thunders down the mountainside. He hurls batarangs and fires his grappling hook to pin the slope in place, but each line snaps and everything begins to **collapse**. Trees and monkeys tumble past, and the whole cliff goes on to **collapse** in a neat ring around him, leaving Batman standing in the dust, brooding.

The {Joker} strolls into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} and prises open a giant *shell*, where a bank clerk sits with *long hair* scribbling sums on the walls by itself.
